headline: Executive order sets up a federal interagency committee to monitor and enforce environmental commitments under the US-Mexico-Canada trade agreement.
what_it_does: This order creates an Interagency Environment Committee, as called for by Section 811 of the law that put the United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement (USMCA) into effect. The committee's job is to monitor how Mexico and Canada meet the environmental commitments in the trade deal and to support enforcement of them. No summary was provided, so details about membership and specific duties are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies involved in trade and environmental policy
who_it_affects.how: Officials from these agencies would take part in the new committee's monitoring and enforcement work.

who_it_affects.group: Businesses that trade with Mexico and Canada
who_it_affects.how: They could be affected if the committee's monitoring leads to enforcement actions under the trade agreement's environmental rules.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 28, 2020; executive orders typically take effect when signed.
